Eligibility

Min 60% aggregate (3 subjects) in Physics + Maths + one of Chemistry / Biotechnology / Biology / Computer Science / IT / Informatics Practices / Engineering Graphics / Botany & Zoology; age 16y6m on 31 July

Source conflict. In 4 of 5 offerings of this programme, SRM's table still carries older text that says 50% (learn about this source conflict).

How to Apply
Check the official 2026-27 eligibility criteria on SRM’s engineering admissions page .
Apply once on SRM’s official B.Tech application form .
Choose your campus, programme and specialisation at counselling. Note: campus and programme are chosen at counselling; the application form collects preference for statistics only.
Built at SRM

Start-ups, engineering teams, and projects created by alumni and students of this programme:

startup 4 documented facts
Abhinava Rizel: EV motors

Linkage: Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechanical and Automotive departments.

Developed electric-vehicle motors using a hybrid radial-flux design between synchronous reluctance (SynRM) and permanent-magnet synchronous (PMSM) motors.
Reports 8 patents filed and another 10 under filing for EV motor and powertrain technology.
Secured an investment from MM Forgings Ltd.
Founded by alumni of the Mechanical and Automotive departments.
